text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident detected - elevated error rate on routing service (route-evaluator) affecting tier assignment. Pager: sam_oncall. auto-creator: routing-policy-alert

sam_oncall: I’m on it. Can someone pull the initial blast radius?

lee_sre: Looking at alerts — spike in 503s and tenant misroutes since 07:03 UTC. Most failures are tenants with hosted-tier=standard. Some requests are being routed to dedicated pools (dedicated-v2) unexpectedly.

maria_runtime: Confirmed: KV log shows `policy_decision=DEDICATED` for requests that should be HOSTED. Stack trace shows fallback path triggered from `tier_matcher -> variant_fallback` at 07:02:43.

jon_platform: Rolling recent policy change at 07:00? I deployed an experiment to relax host->dedicated affinity for cold-starts (rule id: pol_exp_20260307). Rolling back now.

lee_sre: Please hold traffic while we validate. @sam_oncall can you trigger maintenance mode for the affected route group?

sam_oncall: Putting route-group `rg-hosted-standard` in maintenance (no new assignments) now. Command: `/routes pause rg-hosted-standard --reason "mitigating misroute"`

incident-bot: Command accepted. `rg-hosted-standard` paused by sam_oncall at 07:12:05 UTC.

eva_support: What customers are impacted? Any paying customers seeing errors? I have a support thread from tenant `acme-analytics` reporting timeouts.

carla_custsucc: Acme + 5 smaller tenants. Traffic percentages: Acme ~18% of that route, others <5% each. They're seeing request timeouts and occasional model mismatch (responses from a different model variant). They reported that responses are slower but sometimes succeed.

maria_runtime: Key root cause: the new policy rule `pol_exp_20260307` incorrectly included a membership check that treats `hosted-tier=standard` as eligible for `dedicated-fallback` if queue_latency > 80ms. We intended >800ms. Typo in ms threshold. So low-latency requests were spilling into dedicated variant.

lee_sre: Oof. That explains wrong model variant + tenant bleed. Attack plan: 1) revert policy rollout (jon) 2) drain misassigned requests from dedicated pools (maria) 3) run validation to ensure host pins restored (sam) 4) notify customers (carla/eva)

jon_platform: Reverting rollout now: `policy rollback pol_exp_20260307 --version previous` -> started at 07:14:20 UTC.

incident-bot: Policy rollback job submitted (job id 0x7f9c). Estimated completion ~20s.

maria_runtime: Meanwhile I'm adding a temporary matcher override: `force_tier=HOSTED` for tenants flagged in ACL: [acme-analytics, beta-labs, demo-inc] on route `rg-hosted-standard`. Applying now.

sam_oncall: Override applied at 07:15:05 UTC.

lee_sre: Maria, can you also scale down any dedicated-v2 workers handling these tenants so we don't keep serving wrong variant while rollback completes?

maria_runtime: Yes — issuing drain: `workers drain --pool dedicated-v2 --tenant-filter "tenant in (acme-analytics, beta-labs, demo-inc)"` -> started.

jon_platform: Rollback completed at 07:15:45 UTC. Policy state: previous stable.

incident-bot: Alert cleared? No — backend metrics still show some residual 5xx due to in-flight requests and a few sticky routing connections.

lee_sre: Expected. Keep drains running. Sam, once latency/error trend drops below threshold for 10m, remove maintenance and check for regressions in canary.

sam_oncall: Monitoring dashboard: error rate for rg-hosted-standard peaked at 4.3% (baseline 0.2%). After rollback and overrides it's at 1.1% and falling.

eva_support: I've opened priority tickets to the customers. Messaging: we are investigating a routing misconfiguration causing some requests to be routed to dedicated variants; mitigation in progress and we will follow up with postmortem.

carla_custsucc: Sending a short status note to Acme and Beta: "temporary routing misconfiguration; most traffic restored; we will update in one hour or when resolved."

maria_runtime: Dedicated pool drain shows 84% of affected workers drained. Remaining 16% serving long-running sessions; TTLs expire ~6m. No errors being generated from new assignments.

lee_sre: Good. Next: postmortem action items (quick list): 1) Add unit test for ms threshold parsing in policy translation 2) Gate rollout of matcher changes with stricter canary (traffic % and regression window) 3) Add ACL auto-override when policy rollback occurs 4) Improve alert text to include candidate policy id and last deploy user.

jon_platform: I'll patch CI and put a hotfix rollout rule: policy changes with numeric thresholds now require `ms` suffix and bounds checks. Target deploy in 2h.

sam_oncall: Maintenance off scheduled check: if 10m contiguous healthy -> lift maintenance. Currently 07:20 UTC, trending healthy.

incident-bot: Note: Pager handed back to sam_oncall at 07:28:10 UTC. Incident severity downgraded to SEV2.

eva_support: Support tickets updated with current mitigation steps and ETA.

carla_custsucc: Acme replied: "Thanks, appreciate the quick response. Any ETA to full restoration?" I replied: "We expect full restoration within 10-15 minutes barring in-flight drains."

lee_sre: Final checks: confirm ingress logs show `policy_decision=HOSTED` for sample requests from impacted tenants. Maria?

maria_runtime: Samples at 07:30:12 show `policy_decision=HOSTED` and responses match expected model variant. Metrics stable: error rate back to 0.18%.

sam_oncall: Lifting maintenance on rg-hosted-standard at 07:31:00 UTC.

incident-bot: Incident resolved at 07:31:10 UTC. Root cause: typo in policy threshold (80ms vs 800ms) enabling unintended fallback to dedicated. Impact: brief tenant spillover affecting ~6 tenants; peak error rate 4.3%; no data exfiltration. Actions: revert rollout, tenant ACL override, drain dedicated assignments, CI and policy parsing fixes.

lee_sre: Thanks everyone. We'll turn this into a postmortem doc and run a tabletop. Assigning follow-ups: jon -> policy CI hotfix, maria -> auto-override on rollback, carla -> customer followup notes, lee -> postmortem write-up.

carla_custsucc: I'll draft customer outreach and share in #incidents-status once ready.

sam_oncall: Good handoff. Going to sleep :-).

incident-bot: Closing thread (inc-1768429999).
